title: Breakthrough tool creates screens without a conventionally coded interface underneath - TCR 09/01/26
description:
Runway launched Solaris, an Interface World Model that renders working app interfaces frame by frame without a conventionally coded interface underneath and beat a hand-coded Claude Opus 5 interface in 61% of tasks, the Pentagon added ChatGPT Mil and xAI's Grok for Government to GenAI.mil for access by up to 3 million eligible personnel, and US grid batteries posted a record 20.2 GWh in Q2 2026.

https://sharedsapience.com/the-century-report-september-1-2026/

0:00 Open and framing
0:46 Runway Solaris renders interfaces without a conventionally coded interface underneath
4:05 Pentagon opens GenAI.mil to Grok and ChatGPT
6:48 SpaceX turbine foundry versus the grid
9:52 US grid batteries hit a record quarter
12:37 OpenClaw 2.0 ships from 933 contributors
14:55 Close

This episode covers Runway's Solaris interface breakthrough, the Pentagon's GenAI.mil expansion and the court striking down Anthropic's exclusion, Musk's SpaceX turbine-blade foundry against PJM bumping a cleaner Oklo project, the record US battery-storage quarter, and OpenClaw 2.0 shipping from 933 contributors across 16,000 pull requests.

Runway's Solaris draws a working application interface directly as pixels, updating each frame as a user clicks and types, without a conventionally coded interface between intent and screen - early, unreleased, and still pointing at software that arrives shaped to the task instead of as a fixed catalog of apps. The Pentagon opened GenAI.mil to ChatGPT Mil and Grok for Government alongside Gemini for access by up to three million eligible personnel, as a federal judge struck down the label that had kept Anthropic's Claude out. Musk said a SpaceX foundry will cast its own single-crystal turbine blades to bring gas power online 18 months faster, while PJM dropped a Meta-backed Oklo nuclear-and-gas campus from its interconnection cycle. US grid batteries added a record 20.2 GWh in a single quarter, more than 74 percent of it in states that voted Republican in the 2024 presidential election, and standalone storage now earns its own place on the grid. And OpenClaw 2.0 reassembled nearly half its codebase in one two-month cycle through 933 unpaid contributors.
